children: Entegris said its board approved a $500 million share-repurchase program and the company expects to raise its quarterly cash dividend by 10% starting in the first quarter of next year.
The announcements were made at the company's 2026 Capital Markets Day.

Entegris also introduced its updated long-term financial model, which targets a compound annual growth rate for revenue of about 15%. The company is also targeting adjusted gross margin of about 55%, adjusted operating margin of approximately 35%, and adjusted earnings per share CAGR of approximately 30%, it added.

The company has a market cap of $19.55 billion, 152.8 million shares outstanding, and a public float of 151.9 million shares. Its stock gained 9.4% in the day's regular trading session, closing at $140.06.
Entegris supplies critical advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-tech industries.
